easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Sakashima's Student
description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Sakashima's Student by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Sakashima's Student into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sakashima's Student's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Sakashima's Student's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Sakashima's Student's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.
